text.en:
Section twenty-nine of Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and' ninety-six is hereby amended by
adding at the end thereof the following proviso:
"Provided, however, That in the discretion of the Secretary of the Interior the delegate of the Secretary of the
Interior for the non-Christian people may make the official visit and inspection of the special government

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 23, 1914.
